messages:
Alex: Heads-up: release pipeline failed on publish because sdk-go had a regen diff that tightened an optional param into required.
Priya: Which param? Link to diff?
Alex: In generated `clients/pipeline_client.go`, `NewPipelineClient` signature changed from `func NewPipelineClient(url string, opts *ClientOptions)` to `func NewPipelineClient(url string, opts ClientOptions)` (pointer -> value).
Diego: Oof, that makes `nil` callers invalid. That is a breaking change. Did typegen templates change?
regen-bot: regen/trigger/322 produced diffs: packages/typegen/templates/go/client.tmpl -> parameter pointer removed.
Lin: This slipped past because our regen golden tests only check file presence, not signature parity.
Priya: CI policy treats public API surface changes as publish-blocking unless there's a changelog+semver bump. publish job aborted.
release-bot: publish/job/1309 stopped 61 reason: api-surface-regendiff (unexpected signature change)
Alex: Some downstream repos call `NewPipelineClient(url, nil)` — those will panic/compile fail.
Diego: Two options: revert template change (fast) or accept as breaking and add changelog + semver-major and coordinate consumer upgrades (slow).
Priya: Revert for the immediate release. Also file a proper RFC for pointer vs value semantics in generators.
Lin: Agreed. I'll open a small revert PR to templates and add a regen CI test that diffs function signatures (simple grep/AST check).
Priya: Can we add a pre-publish safety check that runs `golangci-lint`-style AST diff across generated public funcs to catch pointer/vs-value and param optionality changes?
Diego: We can write a lightweight script: `scripts/check-gen-signature.sh` that extracts `func New.*Client\(` lines and compares against golden. Put it in `packages/typegen/tests`.
Alex: Also need to update changelog generator to require an explicit entry when any public API symbol changes. It already flags but allowed a bypass via `--force` in a previous merge. Let's tighten that.
Priya: I'll remove the bypass and add a CI gate.
Lin: PR: https://gh.redwood/inference/pulls/900 opened - branch `dx/revert-go-client-pointer-change` (revert + signature-check test).
regen-bot: comment: regen artifacts available at https://ci.redwood/artifacts/322
Alex: Running local reproduce: `yarn regen:go && go test ./...` -> fails in sample-app with `cannot use nil as type ClientOptions in argument to NewPipelineClient`.
Diego: Good catch. We should also add a sample-app smoke job to PR CI that builds a couple of language SDK consumers after regen. That would have caught this earlier.
Priya: Filed issue #2210 to add sample-app consumer builds to typegen PR pipeline.
Lin: CI on `dx/revert-go-client-pointer-change` is green for regen-check + signature test. Merging to unblock.
release-bot: publish/job/1309 re-run queued
Alex: after merge, republished SDKs in staging. Running downstream sample-app build now.
Diego: Downstream build passes. Good.
Priya: Follow-up: create RFC about generator pointer semantics and add an explicit unit-test harness for signature diffs. Also add a lint rule that flags pointer-to-value parameter changes automatically.
Alex: Thank you all. We'll close this thread once the RFC is in backlog and issue #2210 is tracked.
